control.name: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
control.requirement: Information about technical vulnerabilities must be obtained in a timely manner and evaluated.

control.name: Secure Coding Practices
control.requirement: Secure coding principles must be applied to software development through automated SAST analysis.

control.name: Configuration & Infrastructure-as-Code Security
control.requirement: Security configurations in deployment manifests and infrastructure must be continuously validated.

control.name: Access Control & Secrets Protection
control.requirement: Credentials, private keys, and API tokens must be strictly protected and never leaked in code.
